title: Flipside
body: The show on their side. The notes on yours.
notes: You're looking at the audience side of my phone. I'm looking at my notes. Same phone.

title: Every pitch happens on a phone now
body: A realtor. A founder. A doctor. One person across a table.
visual: Three small line-drawn scenes in a row: a realtor, a founder and a doctor, each across a table from one person with a phone standing between them.
notes: Turn your phone around to show them and they see your notes, your texts, everything. Nobody has a tool for this.

title: The fold is the wall
body: Their slides on one side. Your notes on the other.
visual: The phone standing at 90 degrees, two faces labeled Them and You.
notes: Watch the top half. The hinge drives this, not a button.

title: Say a topic, get a deck
visual: The streaming state: a slide card with the title landed, body lines mid-fade, and a verdigris glow on the border.

title: Point at things
body: Your finger on your half. A dot on theirs.
visual: The phone in laptop pose: a trackpad on the flat half, a red dot on the standing half.
notes: The flat half is a trackpad for their screen.

title: Close the phone
body: The recap is already in their inbox.
visual: The phone shut, and a recap notification on a second phone.
